shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab/monument as the carved surface
carving/relief divided into horizontal registers or bands
a row of repeated similar motifs across an upper band
animal figures in profile (birds, quadruped) — birds appear in both
densely covered surface with little empty ground
justification: Both are tall upright stone surfaces whose decoration is organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a row of repeated motifs across an upper band and profile creatures (including birds) below, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a fine linear drawing dominated by rows of dense script beneath a small human offering scene with a rayed disc, while B is a bold, plastic animal relief with no writing and no human figures — the manner of rendering and the actual subject matter are almost entirely different.
